name: challenge-prompt-1
purpose: D16 (owner gate 2026-10-09 / ADR-028 §7): byte-pins the nonce-bound hosting-challenge prompt construction that rides the EXISTING challengePrompt wire field of POST /peers/challenge/start (msp-v1 §3.3). No wire schema changed; the frozen ChallengeCompleteSchema body is untouched. Consumed by apps/tracker (lib/challenge.ts, tests/crypto-vectors.test.ts) and by crates/modelswarm-tracker-api (challenge prompt build/parse).

format.with_pinned_canary: ModelSwarm readiness challenge <challengeId>; greedy-canary sha256:<64 lowercase hex>
format.challenge_id_shape: 32 lowercase hex chars (128-bit id minted per lease+profile at challenge/start)
format.canary_digest_shape: sha256:<64 lowercase hex>; SHA-256 over the greedy canary token stream computed offline by the resolver pipeline under the pinned runtime (E0 determinism). HASH-ONLY: token streams never travel to or through the hub (ADR-001 content-blindness).
format.nonce_binding: The challengeId inside the prompt binds each served prompt to its challenge instance: a solved prompt/timing pair cannot be precomputed against a fixed public constant or replayed across challenges/installations.
format.spot_verification: Digest-based spot-verification by other peers is deferred to the reputation chassis; its sampling rate must be sized from measured detection math (Sarmenta: P(detect within n challenges) = 1-(1-s)^n against a cheater fraction) — TBD-numeric until the E-A detection curves are published. Never invented.
